components.name: Defect-enriched finite-precision operations and operation-path transport
components.project_addition: Treat operation/projection noncommutation as an exact finite defect; separate coordinate-dependent local defects from representation-invariant obstructions; organize mixed-radix detail states as exact finite charts; prove canonical projection paths are flat after transport; and define coherent transport/composition for genuine collapse-versus-projection operation-scheduling holonomy. The project-specific research content is the finite precision-path integration and collapse-holonomy transport, not the established carry-cocycle or group-extension theory.
